newsitem.title: USA: Incentive unit to do dialysis consulting.
newsitem.headline: Incentive unit to do dialysis consulting.

text.p: Gambro Healthcare Inc, a unit of Sweden's Incentive AB, said Monday it has agreed to provide consulting services to four New York-area dialysis clinics owned by Huntington Artificial Kidney Center Ltd.
Terms of the agreement were not disclosed.
The company said with the addition of the new clinics, Gambro Healthcare owns, operates or provides services to 114 dialysis centers serving about 10,300 patients in 21 states and Washington, D.C.
Gambro Healthcare is a unit of Gambro AB, fomerly a public company which now is wholly owned by Incentive AB.
